title: If You Build It, Will They Come?
coreMove: Design the path to the customer with the same seriousness as the product itself.
sourcePressure: The chapter rejects the fantasy that a strong product automatically reaches customers and treats distribution as a core business design problem. The frozen source for this chapter contains no chapter-specific named anecdote beyond author/editor metadata, so examples should use fictional protagonists and stay anchored to verified terms.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Collapsing distribution into generic marketing or hype.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
